Make Puzzle Sets and Help Students Learn through Play!

Many school students find it hard to understand shapes, geometry, and problem-solving through textbooks alone.

They learn better when they can touch, move, and play with what they are learning.

Join us to create Tangram puzzle kits for students in Grades 5 to 7.

A Tangram is a simple puzzle made of geometric shapes. Each kit will come with puzzle pieces and a play sheet.

You will create 2 to 3 puzzle sets during the event. Team Everest will distribute them to school students.

Note: Team Everest will provide all the required materials and guide you throughout the activity.

You just have to commit 2 hours of your time to this activity.

Please go through the eligibly criteria, and event details before signing up.
